pos.personaBrief: 42.43% possession, the lowest of any PL champion, with a transition-based game plan and Ranieri's quote that he won't force possession football; Vardy and Mahrez thrive on space behind.

pro.personaBrief: Schmeichel almost always went long, Vardy sat on the last defender and Mahrez chose a long ball over short options; wins were turned into quick breaks in few passes.

est.personaBrief: A rigid 4-4-2/4-4-1-1 with disciplined banks of four and an unchanged XI, with limited relational play; Mahrez drifted inside and Ranieri gave him freedom.

lar.personaBrief: Full-backs and wingers gave width, with diagonal balls and wide options sought quickly, and Mahrez and Albrighton were key; two real wide men in a 4-4-2.

blo.personaBrief: Mid-low block, sitting deep inside own third by default with compact lines and selective pressing triggers; no relentless counter-press or high press of the build-up.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal marking with man-orientations, protecting space in compact lines; set-piece marking unknown but Vardy stood at the box edge.

pla.personaBrief: The same 4-4-2 in 35 of 38 matches and a stable XI, regardless of opponent; Ranieri kept the plan and adapted to the squad he inherited.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic non-possession side, Ranieri asks why risk conceding for possession; consolidated leads with substitutions and settled for a point at tough games.

sis.personaBrief: A collective effort with everyone working off the ball, including Mahrez and Vardy; ordinary players became champions, though Ranieri freed Mahrez and Kante somewhat.

jog.personaBrief: Pace, tackling and energy defined the team (Vardy, Kante 175 tackles, Drinkwater, Huth and Morgan), with aerial threat on set pieces; technique was secondary.

bas.personaBrief: An experienced, stable XI and small roster with little rotation; no youth emphasis, signings and late bloomers dominated.

lid.personaBrief: Ranieri's relaxed demeanour took pressure off players, he trusted them and gave responsibility, while demanding they run and help when the ball is lost.
